extracted.name: Summer Chicken Salad- little Mayo!
extracted.description: Looking for a chicken salad that is light and not on heavy Mayo?! You just found it!
ingredient_lines: 1 container vanilla yoplait yogurt single size
2 tbsp seasonings - I use a blend w shallots, white pepper, tarragon I like Penzey Spices
Cracked pepper and sea salt to taste
instruction_lines: Shredd chicken set aside - I prefer white meat only but it’s your choice
Juice fresh lemon, set aside juice
Put yogurt in mixing bowl w chicken, add lemon juice and seasonings. Mix
Add grapes to mix and Mayo, mix add salt and pepper
